doc.title: Eiji Kitamura interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 13, 1999

title: Jazz on Japanese radio and young listeners
summary: Few stations play jazz; young people hear loud rock and he listens to classical.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Is jazz healthy? Young players, rock and the future

blocks.x: In Japan now are there radio stations that play jazz?
Very few. Just like here unfortunately. What kind of music are the young people listening to in Japan?
Can I say — loud. Loud music. And many radio stations [grunts] just like this. Just like rock music.
Right. Same thing here then. Same thing. I’m glad that we sent jazz out. I’m not sure I’m glad we sent some of the other music out.
And I listen to the radio, only classic programs. It’s better.
